title: Pustule
problem: Damage = caster Defense × Small (90%), not Intelligence. The other enemies take 200% of that calculated amount. The text implies Intelligence.
notes: Community claim: Deals only ~10% Int, not "small". Evidence: bc_SpellDamage case L1626 @0x141613936 (caster Defense local 0xb818); splash bc_CreatureCast L14367 × 2. Fix sketch: T: "based on the caster's Defense". Or S: point the case at the Int local Triage 2026-10-26: Ruling 2026-10-26 (stat/scope/trigger wording): text matches code. Damage scales off Defense. 2026-10-26: text correction shipped via localization_override (loader text module). | 2026-10-26 realign (text is the contract): text claims "Target takes a small amount of damage". Fix: S: bc_SpellDamage L1626 Pustule case, lea rcx,[rsp+0xb818] (caster Defense) @0x141613b07 -> [rsp+0xb7d8] (casting stat): bytes @0x141613b0b 18 b8 -> d8 b7. vs bugged: depends on the caster. 2026-10-26: built as byte patch SU-0141 (verified against the baseline exe; not yet run in game).

release_notes.intended: The target takes a small amount of damage and all other enemies take 200% of it.
release_notes.actual: In the unpatched game, the damage was based on the caster's Defense.
release_notes.fix: Now it is based on the caster's Intelligence.
